reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Phase 03 misunderstood the validation architecture. The array length validation DOES exist and IS enforced on all paths (gossip, RPC, and database loads). Gossip path: verify_data_column_sidecar (L546-558) checks cells_len==commitments_len==proofs_len before KZG verification. RPC and database paths: deserialization occurs without immediate validation, but ALL columns (gossip, RPC, database) go through verify_kzg_for_data_column_list → validate_data_columns (kzg_utils.rs:84-89) before acceptance. The kzg_utils.rs validation checks that cells.len()==proofs.len()==commitments.len() and returns an error (not a panic) if they mismatch. The claim of 'out-of-bounds panic' is false—the length check at kzg_utils.rs:84-89 prevents any indexing operation. The claim that 'RPC paths bypass the guard' is incorrect—RPC columns are wrapped as CustodyDataColumn, then verified via verify_kzg_for_data_column_list in data_availability_checker.rs:375-381 before use. Spec reference (01e_PARTIAL_W2B3_1771748669.json, lines 244-260): property PROP-6a4369e9-inv-010 requires equal array lengths. The code DOES enforce this requirement on all paths. Severity: Informational—the code is correct by design; no fix needed.
